Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] *[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] *[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] *[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] *[[Confederation]] }} '''Kothlis''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony world located in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]] of the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was the fourth of seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. One of the main Bothan colonies, relatively close to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], Kothlis was an industrial center that supported the technology trade of the motherworld, although it was home to plants of non-Bothan galactic corporations too. ==Astrography== The colony of Kothlis was located in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]] of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] R-14. The planet [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Koth'lar]] in the fourth position. Situated a few [[light-year/Legends|light-years]] away from the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], it was an ideal location for a colony and trade center. Kothlis was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three small lifeless [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and an [[Kothlis asteroid field|asteroid field]]. The moons had been used for various purposes, meeting places, docks or weapon staches, by fringe beings. ==Geography== The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was largely [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]], dominated by the shallow [[Sesseranda Ocean]], one large main continent, and many scenic islands, grouped together in atolls. While most were barren rocks, some were covered in palm trees and dotted with beaches. The [[Water/Legends|water]] in some places was shallow enough for [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to wade through. The planet featured the [[Koth Ice Cap]] at its northern pole and the [[Lis Ice Cap]] at its southern pole. Most of the planet's landmass was concentrated to a single main continent. Almost 60% of it was covered by the [[Arblis Forest]]. The western 40% of the continent was dominated by the north-to-south range of the [[Ragnook Mountains]], surrounded by plains; most of the population was concentrated in the band between the Mountains and the Forest, most notably the [[capital/Legends|capital]] [[city/Legends|city]] [[Tal'cara]]. The western coast of the continent featured the [[Elkit Peninsula]]. Tal'cara housed most of the colony's light industry and hundreds of corporations, however the continent was home to city-sized industrial parks that could not operate in or near the capital; these were self-contained urban centers with their own living quarters, malls, services, maintenance bays and small stations for transportation. The planet owed its breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in part to the [[symbiospore]] [[fungus/Legends|fungus]] which was abudant in Arblis. The product however had a moldy aroma, especially within the forest. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited Tal'cara, he noted to himself that the daytime air smelled of warm and moldy [[cheese/Legends|cheese]].[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] ==Government and politics== During the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Bothan Council]] established a triumvirate of three [[clan]]s to colonize the planet, [[clan Balya]], [[clan Alya]] and [[clan Ilya]]. The Kothlisians were more interested in work and business rather than appearances; as such, the industrial areas of Kothlis were less tidy or groomed than those of the motherworld. Members of the three founding clans occupied a [[Bothan Colonial Board|colonial board]] of 9 Bothans that served as the local body of government. Each consul oversaw an aspect of society, with 3 more representing the founding clans each. Each of the 12 consuls served a 2,500-day term, and if not for exceptional cases, they were always re-elected. The government was a miniature of the [[Bothan Council]] back on Bothawui, with many bureaucratic layers. Its structure was pyramidal: a consul was responsible for choosing and overseeing directors under them, and each director ordered their subdirectors around. Directors could be non-Bothans, and they were always picked according to political maneuvering and favoritism. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] considered Kothlis a low-priority world, and kept a [[Imperial compound (Kothlis)|compound]] with a small retinue of just 24 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and an elite unit of urban [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] patroling the city on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]. The board was overseen by an Imperial [[Consul-General]], who was also in charge of defense and law enforcement, and authority to overturn the board's decisions; however [[Gilad Halsek]] rarely exercised his powers. As a Bothan colony, Kothlis was also a center of industrial espionage. The inept [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[agent/Legends|agents]] assigned on the planet had discovered a spynet facility in an apartment complex of eastern Tal'cara, and the Bothans intentionally used it to feed the Empire misinformation; as well as keeping it blind on the existence of the other safehouses. Most of them were hidden among the warehouses of the Tal'cara [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]]. ==History== [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]], was still a relatively new entity in the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], already notorious for purchasing uninhabited planets to deplete them from their resources. After detailed surveys, that showed [[ore/Legends|ore]] reserves worth of centuries, they decided to purchase Kothlis in order to make permanent settlements there. Raynor outbid the Bothans who wanted the nearby planet for a colony. Clans of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] were imported as manual workers, and built the first installations on the planet: a temporary facility and a [[Abandoned smelting plant|smelting plant]] at the eastern feet of the [[Ragnook Mountains]]. Most of the millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] funded the construction of a huge [[metal/Legends|metallic]] platform near the production centers, in order to build a mega-city on it. However the ore reserves unexpectedly ran out, raising questions about the initial surveys. The floundering led to Raynor's bankruptcy. This gave the Bothans the opportunity to purchase exclusive rights to Kothlis (along with the constructions and the workers), after paying off Raynor's debts. All this was a fraction of the initial cost. After a [[standard month/Legends|month]] of political struggle, three [[clan]]s were chosen to colonize the planet, based on their connections and influence: [[Clan Balya|Balya]] (owing to its connections with the Republic and specialty in datawork), [[Clan Alya|Alya]] (specializing in shipping, mining and construction), and [[Clan Ilya|Ilya]] (specializing in galactic business). Kothlis then was colonized as a manufacturing world. Alya was essential in the knowldge and labor for the construction of Kothlis's infrastructure, as well as some corporations. However most of them were brought thanks to the ventures of clan Ilya. Many of the companies and factories were owned by Bothans, but through some economic reforms (involving taxation, labor cost and other facilities) they attracted at least twenty major off-world corportations to settle there. It is from those companies that the Bothans managed (through some policial machinations) to fund the completion of the city, [[Tal'cara]]. It became a mid- and high-technology industrial world, producing [[computer/Legends|computer]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts. Tal'cara housed most of the colony's light industry and hundreds of corporations; heavy manufacturing plants that were too large or polluting to be built in (or near) a city, were built in different points of the continent, and counted as urban centers. Such corporations were the Bothan-owned droid component manufacturer [[Plextech Plastic Corporation]] and [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]]. Other entities were [[Aquatic Integrated Systems]] and the [[Rysais Producers Co-operative]]. On Tal'cara alone, hundreds of corporations operated. Other smaller clans migrated to the colony, as well as Bothans who were clanless, indebted, or fugitive, who saw a haven of opportunities in the fledgling industrial center. Most who came to the planet were mainly merchants. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] entered the system very rarely. ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|We ''thank'' you for chasing away those Separatist scum who were intent on punishing us for that very loyalty!''"
"''He's ''lying'', masters!''"
"''I ''beg'' your pardon!''"
"''I could feel it in the ''Force'', masters! The first secretary was lying! He probably ''invited'' the Separatists here!|Desark Fey'lya and Ahsoka Tano|''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''}} [[File:Kothlis-negotiations.jpg|thumb|The Jedi negotiate with Desark Fey'lya.]] During the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet seemingly took a neutral stance. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces traveled to Kothlis where the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] hoped to negotiate with the Bothans concerning their loyalty to the Republic. Upon arrival at Kothlis, however, the Republic found a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and engaged in a [[battle over Kothlis]], until they Republic forces destroyed at least one [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] and caused the rest of them to flee. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] with other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon landed on Kothlis and met with the [[First Secretary]] [[Desark Fey'lya]], who thanked the Jedi for saving Kothlis from the Separatists. [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], however, [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that the first secretary was lying. She expressed her thoughts to the rest of the Jedi, telling them that Fey'lya had probably invited the Separatists himself. The first secretary took Tano's words as an insult and left, stating that the Bothans would remain neutral and provide their [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|spying]] services to both sides. ===Galactic Civil War=== During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Clan Balya kept close ties to the Empire; thanks to them, the Imperial presence on the planet was benign. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kothlis was ruled by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Kothlis was the site of the [[Battle of Kothlis]], a battle in a sequence of several in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] attempt to acquire the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. After the plans were stolen, they were decoded in a [[Bothan safehouse]] in [[Tal'cara]]. Luke Skywalker and [[Koth Melan]] observed the decoding but in the midst of it a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] looking for Luke burst in. The data was saved by [[SecOps Four]], a Bothan tech who ran out a back exit but Melan was killed and Skywalker captured. The surviving techs were able to get the computer core up to the waiting [[CR90 corvette/Legends|blockade runner]] [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']], but it was caught by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']]''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'' [[File:BattleofKothlis.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The battle over Kothlis's beaches]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was sent to rendezvous with the ''Razor'', and arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] as the ''Motivator'' was drawing the corvette into its hangar with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. The Rogues successfully downed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warship, but the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] plunged toward the planet, forcing [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] to go down surface to retrieve the plans from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] wreckage. Once the wreckage had been located, [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] led a small strike force of Rebel [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], who were to infiltrate the Star Destroyer and retrieve the plans. All AT-AT and [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] units were able to break out of the warship to assault the [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Kothlis)|Rebel's transport]]. However, the Rogues managed to bring down the heavy walkers in [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]]. After Rogue Squadron successfully breached the hull using [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] bombing runs, the commandos were able to retrieve the plans and send them to Rebel [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' ===Later history=== It was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by Kothlis-born [[Borsk Fey'lya]]. ==Behind the scenes== The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' gives the planet's length of day as 22 '''standard''' hours whereas the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]'' gives it as 22 '''local''' hours. Conversely, the former gives the planet's length of year as 408 '''local''' days, while the latter as 408 '''standard''' days. The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Kothlis in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Sluis sector is actually located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. There are two conflicting sources for the Battle of Kothlis, the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'', and the [[1999]] video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. This article follows the former source, as it is the later source and was pictured in the art book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''. In ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', the location of the ground battle serves as a location for Versus Mode matches. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox|content=
